question: Ibn Battuta, who visited India during Delhi Sultanate, originally belonged to which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Morocco**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ibn Battuta** was a renowned Moroccan explorer who traveled extensively across the Islamic world and beyond in the 14th century.
 
• His travels took him to various parts of Africa, Asia, and Europe, including India during the Delhi Sultanate period.
 
• In India, Ibn Battuta served as a judge (Qadi) in the court of Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq.</
